(() => {
  const sheet = document.createElement('style');
  document.head.appendChild(sheet);
  let parent = document.body;
  const rules = [];
  for (let i=0;i<34;i++) {
    const node=document.createElement('div');node.className='node_'+i;
    parent.appendChild(node);parent=node;
    rules.push('.node_'+i+'{container:level_'+i+' / inline-size;width:'+(i===0?20:10)+'px;height:0}');
    if(i>0)rules.push('@container level_'+(i-1)+' (width:20px){.node_'+i+'{width:20px}}');
  }
  sheet.textContent=rules.join('');
  try { parent.getBoundingClientRect(); return ''; }
  catch(error) { return String(error); }
})()
